Field manual

Infantry

W A S D Move and swim. Hold Shift to sprint and press Space to jump. Use the mouse to aim, left click to fire, 1 for the AK-47, 2 for the RPG and R to reload.

Ground vehicles

E boards an empty vehicle. Drive with W A S D. Aim turrets with the mouse. Left click fires the main weapon. Right click fires the tank’s machine gun or the jet’s missile.

Flight

On the runway, hold W to build speed. Hold Space to lift off, Q to lower the nose and A or D to turn. S slows the jet.

Landing ship

Walk or drive up the lowered stern ramp. Press G at the helm to secure it. Sail with W A S D. Release the throttle near the marked buoys and press G to berth and lower the ramp.

Conquest

Enter a control zone and stay inside to capture it. Enemy presence contests the zone. Hold all three enemy bases for 12 seconds to win.

Command and fight

Press M to switch between the map and your character. Select a friendly AI unit and mark a destination on the map. Orders continue in combat. C changes the camera and Tab opens the roster. On touch screens, drag the right side to aim.
